description:
Ever-E-Day Elite
(Ever-E-Day Elite with E-Assist starts at $3,100)

This is the lightest and most versatile cargo bike out there. With a detachable cargo rack option and a telescoping main frame, this bike can be adjusted to fit any member of your family or friends.

The ride is ultra-smooth and is the No. 1 choice of Bike Friday staff for everyday commuting. It can be equipped with fenders, E-assist, disc brakes, and a variety of front rack and bag mounting options. You can set it up with all the cargo bike accessories you need—from a fast, lightweight bike to a full cargo setup for carrying your child.

A great-riding, affordable e-bike option with endless possibilities, it’s hand-made in Oregon, U.S.A. The base model starts at 26.6 lbs (without E-assist).

Note: Purple bike images are for illustrating accessory package options. You will receive the new diamond frame style shown in the blue bike.

Breaking out of the box of Cargo Bikes

A light, sporty, compact cargo bike with electric assist option and the capacity to haul what you need with nimble elegance. The new Ever-e-Day Elite is stiffer, lighter, has an equivalent capacity, and handles a heavy load with more stability than the original Ever-e-Day. It retains all the same great features and improves on them by adding more! It also rides great with or without e-assist.

With multi-tool adaptability, it changes from a commuter bike (27lbs, with e-assist its 37lbs) to a light cargo bike for your groceries and child, just by adding accessories. The frame adjusts to the world’s widest range of sizes, fitting your whole family. It truly adjusts to your future needs. It does things other bikes just can’t!

For 2023 we have developed a list of additional features and improvements that make the Ever-e-Day Elite a cargo bike that can do even more things no other cargo bike can.

Note: The Ever-e-Day Elite is uniquely different from the Haul-a-Day Elite as it has a shorter wheel base and the rear end has multiple rack options allowing for a super stripped down version for light daily commuting as well as your choice of a regular rear rack or a cargo rear rack that can carry panniers to children and everything in-between.

Twin adjustable main-tubes for twice the stiffness and control with heavy loads. Providing a solid, capable, and sturdy ride without adding weight, and allowing one bike frame to adjust to fit a wide size range of riders (4′-9″ to 6′-6″). A totally different sizing universe from other brands.

1lb lighter frame through triangulated space-frame technology.

Total weight rating at (385lb/174kg) (rider + bike + cargo) GVWR.

Compression-less brake housing for improved braking

Dedicated rear light mount on the optional Diamond Deck

Accessory improvements to the kickstand and the Whoopee Deux bar.

components.description: Mechanical calipers with 160mm rotors. Braking power is proportional to ratio of rotor and tire outer diameter, so 160mm rotors on our wheels have better stopping power than 180mm or 203mm rotors on larger wheels.
Schwalbe Road Cruiser 20" x 1.75" w/ Shraeder valve tubes
Ever-E-Day Minimalist and Commuter will disassemble to fit into a standard airline check-able Samsonite suitcase. 31 x 21 x 12” (varies slightly with component selections)
wide 24mm+ 406mm rims, laced 3-cross to 36 hole disc hubs. Can be converted to tubeless.
